subgoal.rationale: Direct line-of-sight approach toward the primary docking port at [0,0,0]. At 100m range, closing at 1.5 m/s respects the approach speed budget (2.0 m/s limit, max vertical speed 1.0 m/s limit where vz=-0.54 m/s). Concurrently commanding target orientation [1,0,0,0] and zero angular rate to eliminate the 45.3 deg attitude error during transit well ahead of capture.
alternatives: Hold station at 100m (rejected: clear path, propellant intact, unnecessary delay)
Directly adopt RL short lookahead position [79.2, 47.22, 35.2] as waypoint (rejected: unnecessary intermediate stopping waypoint)
Command maximum allowed speed 2.0 m/s (rejected: vertical component limit of 1.0 m/s constrains total vector along line-of-sight to ~1.5 m/s)
subgoal.rl_assessment: Adopted RL proposal's inward closing direction, but scaled velocity up to 1.5 m/s to make full use of the approach speed budget (RL suggested 0.65 m/s). Rejected treating the RL 4-second lookahead position as an intermediate stop.

result.minimum_speed_rule: Transit preference; braking and capture may use zero speed.

Intermediate braking will be managed continuously as range closes toward the 0.02 m capture gate.
alternatives: Adopting RL advisor velocity proposal directly (0.342 m/s closing speed violates current approach limit of 0.285 m/s)
Targeting RL 4-second intermediate waypoint [1.46, 0.76, 0.57] m instead of the docking port at origin

subgoal.rl_assessment: The RL policy proposes a 4-second lookahead position at [1.46, 0.76, 0.57] m and a closing speed of 0.342 m/s. While the directional vector is sound, the proposed speed exceeds the current safe approach speed limit of 0.285 m/s, and its lookahead position is an intermediate step rather than the docking target. The RL proposal is therefore bounded to track the origin directly within the 0.285 m/s envelope.
